units.function: Extensive embedded-Postgres and HTTP suite for a human-only decision-attention projection that merges approvals, interactions, join requests, recovery actions, productivity reviews, blockers, reviews, exhausted runs, budget incidents, Agent errors and first-class decisions into ranked, deduplicated, queueable and dismissible work.
units.dependencyDirection: AttentionService reads many operational/domain tables and user-specific dismissal/triage/queue state, constructs a common projection with source details and decision actions, ranks/filters/pages it, and exposes it through board-only routes; it does not own the underlying approval, run, Issue or Agent lifecycle.
units.keyDataModels: Attention source kind/id/dedup/dismissal key, subject/project/workspace/detail, whyNow/entryRule/exitRule/decisionVerbs/rank, approval/interaction/review/blocker/run/budget/Agent status, unblock owner/transition, queue membership/retention, user dismissal/snooze, decideBy/attribution, cursor/snapshot/counts/shelf and decision origin/expiry.
units.lifecycle: Only active human-action sources enter; internal harness, Agent-addressed active work, transient/recovered failures and revision-requested approvals are suppressed. Paused/terminated Agent addressees return work to the board. Newer successful runs remove old failure alerts. Pending interactions are enriched with project, plan, images and action-specific detail; only the newest same-Issue/same-kind confirmation shows. Dismissals are invalidated by newer source activity, snoozes reappear after expiry, blockers collapse into cycle-safe weighted terminal causes, and queues/triage/retention/ranking produce paged or complete snapshots.
units.testAssessment: Twenty-four high-value scenarios exercise ten source families, real joins and ranking, human/Agent routing, recovery suppression, enrichment, dedup, graph cycles, snooze/dismissal invalidation, queue snapshots over 100 rows, paging/filter validation, UTC-week ordering, board-only HTTP access and uniform aging. This is a strong behavioral reference. Missing are query plans/load tests across large tenants, snapshot consistency under concurrent updates, authorization by responsible human/department/project, risk/non-dismissible escalation policy, stable cursor mutation semantics, timezone/locale choices, per-source exhaustive state matrices, information redaction, immutable decision evidence and E2E proof that projected verbs execute the exact displayed revision.
units.designRationale: Reduce board overload by presenting only decisions that currently require a human, explain why each item entered and how it exits, collapse duplicate operational signals, rank by urgency/impact and retain user-controlled queues and triage without changing source-of-truth workflows.
units.companyOsProblem: Agent Boss is a Company OS differentiator: one accountable human needs a trustworthy action queue across several Agents, approvals, data risks, evidence, failures and organizational dependencies, with no important responsibility silently hidden.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT this as the leading reference for an AttentionProjection read model: common source envelope, explicit entry/exit/why-now/action verbs, cycle-safe blocker impact, recovered-failure suppression, source-version-aware dismissal and paged snapshots. Rebuild from Company OS events/projections, partition by accountable human/position/data contract, attach risk/SLA/evidence/action digest, make high-risk items non-dismissible or escalation-bound, and verify every verb against the displayed source revision.
units.responsibilityConflict: The feed is Company-wide for any admitted board user rather than routed by accountable role. Agent-attributed triage can snooze human decisions; complete snapshots deliberately bypass safety limits; same-Issue/same-kind logic hides older still-pending confirmations; and generic dismiss/snooze can suppress approvals without a risk policy. Projection details do not bind the responsible human, exact permission/data grants or immutable evidence revision.
